title.narrative: Increased capacity of Members States to make social dialogue more influential and labour relations institutions and processes more effective

description.narrative:
The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area.
(1) Enhancement of the knowledge base to support action on social dialogue and labour relations, primarily through the continuous updating of ILO databases on labour relations, the repository of knowledge on cross-border social dialogue and the database on social dialogue institutions. (2) Development of a new edition of the flagship report on social dialogue and other knowledge products, including on effective labour dispute prevention and resolution systems, and on the role and inclusiveness of social dialogue and labour relations to deliver sustainable outcomes in all policy areas covered by the ILO programme. (3) Capacity development programmes on social dialogue, access to justice and sound labour relations in cooperation with the Turin Centre and other partners (4) Advocacy, policy, and training tools to strengthen constituents’ capacity to participate in UN processes and to ensure the effective mainstreaming of social dialogue and tripartism into all policy areas of the ILO’s work, in Decent Work Country Programmes and in UN Cooperation Frameworks.
